description: This script is used to test if a specified TCP host and port are available, supporting options for timeout, quiet mode, strict mode, and executing commands after the check.

methods.name: echoerr
methods.description: Outputs error messages to stderr if not in quiet mode.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: wait_for
methods.description: Waits until the specified host and port are available or timeout occurs.

methods.name: wait_for_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps wait_for to support SIGINT during timeout, manages process execution.
